entries.case: forced-colors: hero text left on the photograph
entries.reason: The generic case appends forced-colors CSS for .hero-text, .hero h1 and .hero .eyebrow, which Firelight does not have: its hero text is .beat-0 h1, .beat-0 .eyebrow and .beat-0 .lede. The project-owned case of the same name in engineering/checks/je-selftest-gate2.mjs forces exactly those elements onto the photograph and must catch the defect in the same run.
